answer: Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 4 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. Because the ripple reference is updated at each quartz checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the harbor audit records how much each answer added. Repeating an already-covered mechanism as a result earns nothing extra, so one template cannot burn for 74 aliases however many keys the operator holds. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
